jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Solutions Architecture (SA) organization helps Stripe's most strategic customers design and validate technical solutions that drive their business forward. Within SA, our team builds the tools, workflows, and custom technical assets that make the broader SA org more effective—turning individual ingenuity into org-wide capability.

We are looking for AI Engineers who are energized by working close to the business and the users we serve. You'll operate as an embedded, high-context engineer focused on the highest-leverage opportunities across the SA org—building production-quality tooling, supporting our most strategic engagements, and shipping automation that meaningfully improves how Solutions Architects work every day.

What You'll Do

As an AI Engineer, you'll be embedded directly with the Solutions Architecture team—building alongside them, deeply understanding their workflows, and shipping tools and automation that permanently change how they operate. Your measure of success is SA productivity: the engagements you've accelerated, the workflows you've transformed, and the tools you've built that the org adopts as default.

You'll ship code daily. You'll discover where SAs lose time and build high-impact solutions. You'll take what works for one person and scale it to work for the org. And when our most strategic customer engagements need custom technical assets, you'll build those too.

This is a role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of engineering and business impact—close to customers, close to revenue, and building for people you can see using your work every day.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with Solutions Architects, SA leadership, Product, and Engineering to scope technical work and translate ambiguous business needs into well-defined deliverables
Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities (LLMs, agents, workflow automation) where they provide genuine leverage—not for novelty, but for measurable productivity improvement
Architect and build internal tools, agents, and automated workflows that accelerate SA and manager productivity across technical discovery, solution design, demoing, user engagements, territory/pipeline management, and product interlock
Take high-potential tools and workflows built by SAs and managers and harden them into scalable, maintainable, production-grade solutions
Identify patterns across SA workflows and proactively build solutions that address recurring friction
Build custom demo environments, PoC applications, and technical assets for Stripe's most strategic customer engagements
Document tools, architectures, and usage patterns so others can adopt and extend what you've built
Debug, extend, and maintain backend systems across a variety of codebases and infrastructure

Minimum Requirements

4+ years of experience as an engineer shipping production systems
Strong backend engineering fundamentals: you can debug a failing system, trace issues across services, and reason about data flows
Experience building and deploying AI agents, LLM-powered tools, or workflow automation beyond basic prompt engineering
Experience scoping and delivering work with minimal oversight in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment
Proficiency in at least two of: Ruby, Node.js, Python, or Next.js
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) including deployment, monitoring, and basic DevOps
Experience building internal tools, developer platforms, or workflow automation
Demonstrated ability to work across multiple codebases and technology stacks simultaneously
Hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools in your engineering workflow—you're fluent with AI-assisted development but not dependent on it; you can reason through problems and debug without AI as a crutch
Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can translate technical decisions for non-technical stakeholders and navigate cross-functional collaboration naturally
Comfort with ambiguity—you can take a loosely-defined business problem, scope the engineering work, and ship iteratively without waiting for a perfect spec

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing systems that non-engineers can build on top of or extend themselves (e.g., platforms, low-code frameworks, template systems)
Experience in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or GTM Engineering role—or a product engineering role where you worked closely with customers or go-to-market teams
Familiarity with Stripe's products, APIs, or the payments/fintech domain
Experience integrating with third-party platforms (Salesforce, Gong, etc.)
Track record of building tools or systems that were adopted beyond your immediate team
Background in consulting, professional services, or other roles that blend technical depth with business context

Who You Are

Beyond the technical requirements, we're looking for a specific kind of engineer:

You want to be close to the business. You're energized by seeing your work directly impact how a sales team wins a deal or how a customer succeeds.
You're a pragmatic builder. You ship working solutions quickly, iterate based on real usage, and know when "good enough now" beats "perfect later." You'd rather show a working prototype today than present a roadmap deck next quarter.
You're a software engineer by practice. You can architect systems, debug production issues, write clean code, and reason about tradeoffs. AI is a tool in your belt, not a substitute for engineering judgment.
You're a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it generalizes. You think in reusable systems, not one-off scripts.
You thrive without a traditional product team structure. No PRDs landing in your lap, no dedicated PM, no sprint ceremonies. You identify the highest-leverage problem, scope the work, and ship it. You're comfortable trading on-call rotations and rigid processes for autonomy and impact.
You're a strong communicator. You can partner with SAs who are domain experts, understand their workflows deeply enough to build great tools, and explain your technical choices to leadership.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $172,600 - $258,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

jobs.description:
This position offers the flexibility of a hybrid schedule with the expectation of 3 days per week in our Wilmington, DE office, and 2 days remote from home.

Sargent & Lundy’s Grid business group delivers complex engineering work that supports the planning, design, and modernization of electric power infrastructure. This role brings AI, automation, and software engineering directly into that work. As the Grid Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will partner with engineers, project teams, and business leaders to understand how work is performed, identify practical opportunities to improve it, and build solutions that fit the realities of engineering delivery.

Essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Serve as the dedicated AI and automation technical partner for Grid, participating in relevant project, discipline, and business-group discussions to keep solution work connected to delivery needs.
Learn and apply the group’s project workflows, engineering deliverables, data, and tools to identify where automation or AI can reduce effort, improve access to information, support consistency, or accelerate work.
Evaluate proposed work for business value, technical feasibility, data readiness, integration needs, delivery effort, and operational readiness.
Recommend the simplest fit-for-purpose approach, including process improvement, traditional software, scripting, workflow automation, AI, or a combination.
Translate engineering and project needs into clear requirements, options, estimates, success measures, and delivery plans.
Build and test focused prototypes using approved tools and patterns, which may include Glean Agent Builder, Python, and the enterprise AI and automation technology stack.
Validate solutions with the engineers and project staff who will use them, using representative workflows and data; refine, stop, or recommend next steps based on evidence.
Design solutions to support engineering teams and workflows without obscuring assumptions, bypassing required reviews, or substituting AI output for accountable engineering judgment.
Work with Grid subject matter experts to validate outputs and define appropriate human review, escalation, and exception handling, especially when results may inform engineering decisions or project deliverables.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
At least six (6) years of professional experience in an engineering, technical, or analytical discipline, with substantive familiarity with Grid or comparable engineering project workflows, deliverables, data, and stakeholder needs.
Ability to build working technical solutions. Python is preferred; experience with scripting, Excel automation, macros, CAD or engineering-tool scripting, or comparable automation is also relevant.
Demonstrated ability to work with stakeholders to understand a problem, assess feasibility, and translate needs into a practical technical solution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to examine an engineering or business process and identify where technology can help and where it cannot.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical options and limitations to engineering and non-technical audiences.
Willingness to work within established intake, prioritization, governance, review, and documentation processes.
Genuine interest in AI and automation, evidence of self-directed learning, and adaptability as tools and practices evolve.

Valued, But Not Required Qualifications

Experience supporting electric power or Grid engineering work, such as transmission, substations, protection and control, grid planning or system studies, interconnection, or grid modernization, as relevant to the assigned team.
Experience developing or deploying AI/ML, generative AI, workflow automation, or RPA solutions in a business or engineering environment.
Experience with Power Automate, UiPath, or comparable workflow and low-code/no-code platforms.
Familiarity with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, APIs, enterprise integrations, and cloud services on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Professional Engineering (P.E.) license or other discipline credentials relevant to the assigned Grid work.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work.

We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools.

Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. The OpenAI Deployment Company (“DeployCo”) is the deployment arm of OpenAI, purpose-built to deliver enterprise AI transformation at scale. As model capabilities accelerate, deployment has become the primary constraint to realizing AI value creation within large enterprises. DeployCo bridges that gap.

Our ambition is to build the company that defines AI deployment. We operate at the intersection of cutting-edge AI, enterprise transformation, and scaled services delivery. We partner with enterprise customers to identify where AI can transform their businesses and build solutions leveraging OpenAI’s models and products. We work with many of the world's largest and most influential companies to solve their most complex business challenges using the latest advances in AI.

People who thrive at DeployCo get excited about ambitious and complex work. We are deep believers in the future with AI. We execute quickly, value intellectual honesty, and obsess over the solutions we build for our customers. DeployCo is being built from the ground up as a subsidiary of OpenAI and funded with a partnership of outside investors

About the Role

As a Founding Forward Deployed Engineer, you will operate as a technical lead on high-stakes, ambiguous customer deployments and own both technical and business value outcomes end-to-end. You will set the bar for customer engagement and deployments of our technology, helping establish the foundation for OpenAI Deployment.

You will ramp quickly toward management responsibilities and help grow a team that can operate under pressure to deliver meaningful outcomes for customers. You will also help shape how AI can be leveraged to drive real-world impact, as well as how the team organizes to deliver that impact. You will partner closely with OpenAI’s core functions to ensure field work informs roadmap priorities, drives new exploration, and supports safe deployment at scale.

This role is based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office and offer relocation assistance. This role will also require up to 50% travel.

In this role, you will:

Act as the technical lead for customer engagements, owning problems end-to-end from definition to resolution
Operate with strong agency, delivering outcomes through clarity, speed, tight coordination, and high technical quality
Guide deployment strategy and help define DeployCo’s operating model for swift, safe execution
Define and build deployment primitives that increase both customer impact and engagement velocity
Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for execution while helping grow the team through direct, actionable feedback
Codify successful patterns into tools, playbooks, and roadmap inputs that create leverage for Deploy
CoIdentify early signals and escalate them with urgency—whether in product behavior, customer environments, or delivery practices

You may thrive in this role if you:

Bring 4+ years of engineering experience
Have 0→1 experience building reusable capabilities under ambiguity, and can make disciplined standardization-versus-customization decisions instead of defaulting to bespoke work
Have led high-pressure technical projects from prototype to production
Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using JavaScript or Python
Simplify complex work and make fast, sound decisions under pressure
Elevate team performance through clarity rather than process overhead
Operate with urgency in ambiguous or evolving environments
Translate field experience into clear, actionable feedback for Product and Research
Build deep trust with teammates by modeling calm, focus, and strong judgment when it matters most

Write production-grade code (Python, Go, TypeScript) to integrate AI Gateway with microservices, API meshes, and multi-cloud architectures.

Develop automated deployment modules (Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes) and SDK wrappers.

Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration, prompt security, token optimization, model routing, and vector databases/RAG architectures.

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About The Role

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer at Commure, you'll play a crucial role in collaborating directly with healthcare clients, understanding their needs, and actively participating in the design and implementation of customized solutions. This immersive experience offers you the chance to be at the heart of healthcare technology, contributing to projects that enhance patient access, affordability, and care quality.

In this highly visible position, you'll provide essential technical support, tackle various challenges, and maintain vital documentation. Additionally, by keeping pace with evolving healthcare technology trends, you'll contribute innovative ideas and solutions. Your contributions will be instrumental in advancing our mission to revolutionize healthcare through technology.

What You’ll Do

Be willing to travel up to 20% of the time to client site, build on site, and demo.
Participate in the implementation process, aiding in the integration of our solutions into client settings.
Provide technical assistance and contribute to problem-solving during deployment and integration phases.
Work collaboratively with healthcare clients to understand their technology needs, compliance requirements, and patient care goals.
Support our development and engineering teams in crafting tailored solutions for the healthcare industry.
Help identify and address technical challenges encountered during project implementation.
Assist in creating and updating technical documentation to streamline client onboarding and system maintenance.
Keep informed about the latest trends in healthcare technology and regulations to help propose relevant solutions.
Visit new places and meet interesting people in the heart of healthcare

What You Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
4+ years of professional software development experience or a similar role
Strong knowledge of full-stack engineering principles and system design.
Experience with programming languages such as Python, Javascript, React, and SQL.
Experience building 0-1 products
Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and effective communication abilities.
Eagerness to collaborate and ability to engage confidently with clients.
Adaptability and enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, client-focused healthcare environment.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

This is a client-facing engineering role for someone who wants to spend their days with customers, not building a product. Our client is a consulting organization that builds production-grade applications, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows for clients across industries. Every engagement is a service: you embed with the client, learn how their business actually runs, and deliver software that solves their specific problem.
You will own the technical solution end to end, from early prototype through production on live client data. You will work alongside a Delivery Manager who owns scope and business outcomes, while you own the build and much of the day-to-day client conversation. The work spans post-acquisition data migrations, document pipelines, custom operational apps, CRM and revenue operations, and agentic systems that automate repetitive work. If you get energy from sitting with operators, running demos for executives, and seeing a client’s team use what you built the following week, this role is built for you.

Who you are:

You love working with customers. Client conversations, workshops, and on-site sessions are the best part of your week, not a distraction from coding.
You prefer services over product. You find it rewarding to solve each client’s problem well, even when the solution is bespoke. You are not looking to move onto a core product team or build a platform.
You are a strong engineer with a track record to show for it. You have four or more years of real production ownership and a clear signal of strong competence, such as time at a top-tier engineering company or results in competitive math or programming.
You turn ambiguity into working software. You make practical implementation decisions without waiting for every detail to be specced out, and you ask focused questions when something is unclear.
You communicate clearly with everyone in the room, from frontline operators to executives.
You are based in New York and comfortable traveling to client sites.

Key Responsibilities

Act as a primary technical point of contact for client stakeholders, building trust through regular on-site sessions, demos, and working meetings
Collaborate with the Delivery Manager and client teams to understand workflows, inspect real examples, and define what the application needs to do
Build working versions early to test assumptions, run client demos, and iterate from direct feedback
Take applications into production on real client data, agreeing on milestones and delivery tradeoffs and surfacing scope or timeline changes before making new commitments
Own testing, debugging, production fixes, and ongoing improvements; handle incomplete inputs and errors; and make failures visible and recoverable
Integrate clean data into ERPs, CRMs, and data warehouses; stand up agents that handle repetitive operational work
Reuse existing components where they fit, and share recurring client patterns with the core engineering team so future engagements move faster
Explain technical choices clearly to non-technical stakeholders and raise blockers with a diagnosis and a proposed next step

Required Skills & Experience

4+ years building and delivering production software with real ownership of outcomes
Genuine enthusiasm for client-facing, services-oriented work, and a preference for delivering solutions to clients over building a product
Fluency in TypeScript with practical React, Node.js, API, and database experience across frontend, backend, and database layers
Practical Python and SQL experience for integrations, data processing, and AI workflows
Demonstrated experience with agentic systems: ability to show what you have built, explain where it failed, and describe how you fixed it
Ability to verify generated code and explain and debug everything you deliver
Strong implementation judgment: turning incomplete briefs into working software and asking focused questions when something is unclear
NYC-based and comfortable traveling to client sites

Preferred Skills

A record of standout technical achievement, such as engineering experience at a top-tier technology company or strong results in competitive math or programming (e.g., math olympiads, Putnam, ICPC)
Experience working directly with executives or operators in a client-facing or consulting context
Familiarity with post-M&A data migration or data reconciliation work
Experience replacing manual or spreadsheet-driven workflows with production software
Comfort working without detailed engineering tickets and keeping code simple, readable, and easy to change

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Jade Global is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer for our Native AI Services business within the AI Engineering service line. You will work directly with enterprise customers to understand their business workflows and build custom AI applications and agentic solutions that deliver measurable results.

You will own the technical journey from discovery and solution design through deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. The role combines hands-on software engineering with customer engagement, working alongside an initiative-sized team of AI, data, integration, and product engineers across Jade's onshore and offshore delivery teams.

What You Will Do

- Discovery & Design: Lead discovery with business users and technology teams to map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and define success criteria. Translate customer priorities into practical solution designs and delivery plans.
- Build & Integrate: Build production-quality AI applications, agents, APIs, retrieval pipelines, orchestration logic, and user interfaces. Connect solutions to enterprise applications and data sources, ensuring proper authentication, permissions, and data quality.
- Testing & Evaluation: Establish evaluation datasets and acceptance criteria to test task completion, output quality, latency, and cost before and after deployment.
- Production & Operations: Implement access controls, auditability, monitoring, safe fallbacks, and human approvals. Manage operational handovers and troubleshoot post-launch issues.
- Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction to the delivery team while actively writing and reviewing code. Surface risks early and communicate architecture tradeoffs to customers.
- Impact & Reusability: Measure adoption and business impact against baseline metrics, converting successful patterns into reusable components for Jade Orbit and FDE delivery methods.

What You Bring

- Experience: 6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 2+ years building LLM-powered applications or agentic systems with multiple production deployments.
- Core Engineering: Strong Python skills (asynchronous programming, API development, automated testing, debugging) and solid grounding in SQL, data structures, and distributed systems.
- AI Architecture: Deep understanding of LLM architecture (model selection, embeddings, context management, structured outputs, tool calling, inference tradeoffs).
- Agentic Systems & RAG: Hands-on experience engineering agents/orchestration frameworks (state management, persisted checkpoints, retries, idempotent execution) and building/tuning RAG pipelines.
- Evaluation & Testing: Experience developing AI evaluations using representative datasets, task-level metrics, regression tests, and adversarial cases.
- Integration & Security: Strong enterprise integration skills (APIs, auth, databases) and practical experience securing AI applications (prompt injection defense, least-privilege access, audit trails).
- Cloud & Operations: Production deployment experience on a major cloud platform (containers, CI/CD, secrets management, tracing, cost control).

Valuable Experience

- Previous work as an FDE, customer engineer, technical consultant, technical founder, or solutions architect with substantial coding ownership.
- Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, Model Context Protocol integrations, LLM observability, or open-source model fine-tuning.
- Industry delivery experience in manufacturing, high-tech, or healthcare/life sciences.

How Success Will Be Measured

- Time to a useful first release and progression to reliable production use.
- Adoption and measurable improvements in customer workflows (cycle time, quality, productivity, cost).
- Solution reliability, evaluation results, and management of operating costs.
- Customer trust, clear technical ownership, and creation of reusable engineering assets.

jobs.title: Research Scientist — Computational Connectomics
jobs.description:
About Astera:

Astera is a private foundation on a mission to steer science and technology toward a better future. We believe the coming years will bring an era of unprecedented scientific and technological advancement as exponential progress in AI converges with central advances in other fields to accelerate innovation. This inflection point provides an unparalleled opportunity to fundamentally rethink the institutions, systems, and tools that drive progress. We have committed a $3.5B endowment to that work and fit the form of our support to the function it serves: grants, investments, and in-house research programs. We accept meaningful risk in the research we back and expect some of it to fail because transformative ideas are rarely the ones already proven. Our projects, and the foundation itself, operate like high-velocity startups, with a high performance bar and competitive compensation to match. We are searching for leaders who are compelled by the challenge of driving high-impact change in the way science is funded, conducted, and communicated. You can read more about our mission, vision, and programming at astera.org/vision.

Project Summary:

We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action.

Our strategy starts with developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior, and applying specific mechanism to make robots useful. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a Research Scientist to find how specific fly circuits produce behavior and to turn those mechanisms into models that run on robots. We don't simulate the whole brain. We study modular circuits one at a time. Each project starts with neurons that experiments have linked to a behavior. We then use the connectome to find candidate circuit motifs and to rule out mechanisms the wiring can't support, and we test competing models against neural data, in simulation, and then apply them on physical robots. We welcome applicants from neuroscience, engineering, physics, computer science, and related quantitative fields. This position reports to Chongxi Lai, who leads Astera's Robotics team.

This is a full-time position.

Responsibilities:

Choose tractable circuits from the literature. Review experimental studies to find behaviors with strong neuron–behavior evidence, such as recordings, activation or silencing experiments, and behavioral assays. Judge which circuits are ready for mechanistic modeling.
Use the connectome to generate and constrain hypotheses. Find the identified neurons in the connectome. Trace their inputs, outputs, and recurrent connections, and pull out candidate circuit motifs. Use the wiring to rule out mechanisms the anatomy can't support, and be clear about what it leaves open, such as synapse sign and strength, neuromodulation, and intrinsic dynamics.
Build and compare competing circuit models. Test models against neural recordings, behavioral measurements, and perturbation data to find which mechanisms explain the behavior and which circuit elements are necessary.
Test models in closed loop, in simulated fruit fly or robots. Work with robotics researchers to put models into simulated and physical bodies. Measure how behavior changes with sensory cues, body dynamics, noise, and task demands.
Make predictions for new fly experiments. Use closed-loop results to refine models and derive quantitative predictions. Work with experimental collaborators to design perturbations that distinguish competing models.
Help apply learnt mechanisms to robotics. Turn validated circuit mechanisms into algorithms, or algorithmic principles for robot perception, learning, or control on navigation or manipulation tasks.
Build a reusable workflow. Develop shared tools and analysis pipelines so each new circuit goes faster than the last. Share models, code, and findings.

Qualifications:

Required

PhD or equivalent research experience in neuroscience, computer science, physics, applied mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative field.
Demonstrated experience building mechanistic models of neural circuits that are constrained by, and tested against, experimental data.
Ability to read experimental literature critically: weigh the strength of neuron–behavior evidence, interpret recordings and perturbations, and turn them into testable predictions that distinguish competing mechanisms.
Ability to make principled modeling choices with incomplete data, such as wiring diagram with approximate synaptic counts but without exact synaptic weights and to state which conclusions depend on those choices.
Strong programming and quantitative skills, such as dynamical systems, statistical inference, graph analysis, optimization, or machine learning. Experience building reproducible scientific analyses and simulations.
Interest in embodied intelligence and ability to collaborate across neuroscience, AI, and robotics.

Bonus Experience

Familiarity with Drosophila neuroanatomy, behavior, or genetic tools. Hands-on experience with connectome datasets (e.g., FlyWire, hemibrain, MANC, BANC), including matching experimentally characterized neurons to reconstructed cells.
Experience modeling recurrent dynamics, plasticity, neuromodulation, or sensorimotor feedback.
Experience with embodied simulation (e.g., NeuroMechFly, flybody, MuJoCo, IsaacSim), physical robots, robot learning, or control, including models that interact with body mechanics.
A record of theoretical predictions that were tested experimentally, ideally with experimental collaborators.

Location:

This position can be based on-site in Emeryville, California (San Francisco Bay Area), or remote anywhere in the US.

Compensation:

This role’s pay range is $120,000 to $180,000, based on experience, skills, and location.

As a nonprofit organization, we're exempt from the H-1B cap; visa sponsorship may be available for qualified roles.

Benefits
:

Top tier health insurance plans with 99% of premiums covered by Astera for employees and dependents
Daily lunch that brings the full office together, plus a well-stocked fridge and pantry
Licenses for frontier AI tools and software
403(b) retirement plans, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, commuter benefits, and health and dependent care FSAs

Equal Opportunity Employment & Accommodations

Astera Institute is an equal opportunity employer and is invested in fostering a culture where everyone can thrive. We are committed to equity and inclusion, and we encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, older members of society, and others from minority communities and diverse backgrounds to apply.

Astera Institute is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in the job application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please contact us at recruiting@astera.org and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Compensation Range: $120K - $180K

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. jobs.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Marketing Data Scientist to advance how we measure the true incremental impact of marketing investments and translate those insights into better business decisions. This role will serve as a technical leader for causal measurement and experimentation, developing rigorous approaches to answer a fundamental question: What business outcomes occurred because of our marketing investments that would not have occurred otherwise? The Lead Data Scientist will design and analyze randomized and quasi-experimental studies across marketing channels, audiences, geographies, and business initiatives. This includes applying advanced causal inference methodologies such as Synthetic Difference-in-Differences, synthetic controls, geo experiments, matched-market designs, randomized holdouts, and other experimentation approaches.

Day to day, you'll...

Lead causal measurement and incrementality

Design and execute marketing incrementality studies that quantify incremental conversions, new customers, and ROI generated by marketing investments
Develop media incrementality experiments, including appropriate evaluation of pre-treatment trends, treatment timing, heterogeneous effects, and sensitivity to identifying assumptions
Estimate causal effects using longitudinal market, customer, or business-unit data when traditional randomization is not feasible
Build synthetic control and matched-market approaches to construct credible counterfactuals for marketing interventions
Design and analyze geo experiments, customer-level randomized controlled trials, conversion-lift studies, and holdout experiments
Evaluate causal identification strategies and select the appropriate methodology based on available data, treatment assignment, interference, sample size, statistical power, and business conditions
Establish standards for power analysis, minimum detectable effects, test duration, experiment design, confidence intervals, sensitivity analysis, placebo testing, and robustness checks
Identify and address common threats to marketing experiments, including contamination, spillover effects, seasonality, pre-existing trends, selection bias, auction dynamics, and treatment noncompliance

Build an experimentation and measurement framework

Develop a scalable marketing experimentation roadmap across paid search, paid social, display, video, streaming, affiliate, CRM, offline media, and other marketing investments
Establish criteria for determining when to use a randomized experiment versus geo testing, SDID, DiD, synthetic control, or other observational causal methods
Create reusable analytical frameworks, code libraries, validation standards, and reporting templates that allow experiments to be executed consistently
Build processes to feed experimental findings back into MMM and other marketing measurement models, improving calibration and decision-making
Partner with marketing and media teams to prioritize tests based on business impact, learning potential, feasibility, and statistical power

Connect experimentation to marketing investment decisions

Translate causal estimates into incremental conversions, incremental new customers, cost per incremental outcome, incremental ROAS, and marginal ROI
Compare incrementality findings with MMM and attribution results to identify where methodologies converge or diverge
Develop recommendations for budget allocation and optimization based on causal evidence rather than attributed conversions alone
Partner with Marketing, Media, Finance, Go to Market Strategy, and Analytics teams to translate experimental results into actionable investment decisions
Develop executive-ready recommendations explaining not only what happened, but what would have happened without the marketing intervention

Technical Leadership

Serve as a subject-matter expert in causal inference, experimentation, and marketing measurement
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data scientists and analysts on experiment design and causal methodology
Conduct methodological reviews to ensure measurement approaches are statistically defensible and assumptions are transparent
Develop production-quality analytical workflows using Python, SQL, R, PySpark, and cloud-scale data environments such as Azure Databricks
Partner with data engineering teams to create the datasets and pipelines required for scalable experimentation
Communicate sophisticated statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Marketing Analytics, Applied Economics, or a related quantitative discipline, with meaningful experience leading advanced analytical work
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline
Demonstrated experience applying causal inference to real-world business problems
Hands-on experience with multiple causal methodologies, including Synthetic Difference-in-Differences, Geo experiments / matched-market testing, audience holdouts, propensity score or matching methods
Strong understanding of experimental design, hypothesis testing, statistical power, minimum detectable effects, confidence intervals, bias, and variance
Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, or R
Experience working with large-scale datasets in environments such as Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, or comparable cloud data platforms
Ability to translate highly technical findings into clear business recommendations for senior leaders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience applying causal inference specifically to marketing or advertising measurement
Experience with marketing incrementality, MMM, media measurement, attribution, or marketing optimization
Experience designing geo-based marketing experiments across DMAs, states, stores, or other geographic units
Familiarity with advertising-platform lift studies and experimentation frameworks
Experience turning causal estimates into budget allocation or investment optimization recommendations

Why work for us

About Us

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Why We Exist

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.

Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

jobs.title: Sr Research Scientist, Battery Algorithms, Energy Storage, Project Jewel
jobs.description:
Description

Do you want to write the algorithms that control next-generation batteries, and shape the future of energy storage? This role sits where electrochemistry, data/ML, and control theory meet. You will develop the physics-informed and data-driven methods that estimate state of charge, health, power capability, and remaining life, and validate them against lab and fleet data until they are ready to ship. Your algorithms will decide how hard a battery can be pushed, when it needs attention, and how long it will last, so they shape the safety, warranty, and economics of the whole product. You will work side by side with cell, systems, and software engineers, and as an early hire you will help define how we develop and validate battery algorithms.

This role can be based in Boston, Irvine, Sunnyvale, or Seattle, and involves occasional domestic and international travel, up to 10% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

Develop and own algorithms for state of charge, state of health, power capability, and remaining useful life, combining physics-based models with data-driven and estimation methods.
Deliver validated reference implementations, test vectors, and accuracy targets that define what production code must achieve.
Design the test plans and data needed to develop and validate algorithms, working with the cell and testing teams to turn lab and field data into model improvements.
Analyze algorithm performance across the deployed fleet, find where models drift or fail, and drive improvements.
Own the accuracy and robustness of battery algorithms, and sign off that production implementations match the validated reference. Provide algorithm evidence for safety certification.

A day in the life

Your week moves between data, models, and experiments. One day you might be working out why a health estimate drifts on cells that have aged in the field, and the next deciding which model structure holds accuracy at cold temperatures. You could be designing a test with the cell team to expose a behavior your model misses, or reviewing an implementation with an applied scientist to confirm that what ships matches what you validated. You will regularly share results with software, systems, and cell leaders, and your findings will shape decisions well beyond the algorithm itself.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 5+ years of quantitative field research experience
Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive etc.
Experience communicating qualitative research methods and findings to non-qualitative researchers

Preferred Qualifications

Experience converting research studies into tangible real-world changes
Experience with discrete and continuous optimization methodologies and algorithms

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Simulation
jobs.description:
Join the team bringing autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

About The Role

Bedrock Robotics is hiring a Data Scientist to lead the work on Simulation: measuring how realistic our simulator is, and when its results can be trusted. In this role, you will operate as a senior technical individual contributor, partnering closely with simulation, autonomy, machine learning, and evaluation teams to compare simulated runs with real-world data generated by autonomous construction machines and their operators.

You will own the statistical methods behind simulation-based testing (realism metrics, calibration against field data, and the design of simulation experiments) while helping establish foundational practices for how data science is applied at Bedrock. This role is ideal for a senior-to-staff-level data scientist with a strong statistics foundation and experience with simulation or physical systems, who enjoys working close to the engineers building the simulator.

What You'll Do

Own data science for simulation, focusing on the gaps between simulation and the field that most affect release decisions
Analyze field logs and simulated runs side by side to find where simulated machine, soil, and truck behavior departs from reality
Define and track realism metrics that compare distributions of simulated and real behavior (cycle times, bucket fill, arm trajectories, soil response, truck interactions) across simulator versions
Design simulation experiments (number of runs, scenario mix, variance reduction, sequential tests) so comparisons between software versions are powered and unbiased
Collaborate closely with simulation and data engineering teams to extract scenarios from field logs and keep simulated and real data comparable
Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing roadmap and design decisions
Contribute to the foundation of data science practices at Bedrock, helping shape how future work and teams scale
Validate simulation as a predictor: measure how well simulation results predict field outcomes of software releases, and set when a simulation result is strong enough to act on
Calibrate simulator parameters (for example terrain material properties) against field data, with uncertainty
Find which parts of the simulator (soil physics, hydraulics, sensors, other agents) drive the gap to reality, and help simulation engineers prioritize fixes
Build scenario sampling so simulated test suites represent field conditions, and use importance sampling to estimate rare-event rates

What We're Looking For

Required

Experience validating a simulator or physical model against real-world data
5+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or applied machine learning, including work on simulation or physical systems
Comfort operating as a senior IC in a fast-growing startup, balancing execution with technical judgment and prioritization
Ability to work independently, define analytical approaches, and drive projects from concept to insight
Experience working with complex, high-volume time-series data from robots, vehicles, or other physical systems
Strong grounding in statistics: experimental design, variance estimation, comparing distributions, and calibrating models to data, with a track record of influencing decisions through data
Hands-on experience collaborating with simulation, data engineering, and infrastructure teams on data pipelines, data quality, and scalable analysis workflows
Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using modern tooling like agentic AI
Master’s degree in Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

Preferred

Experience with simulation for autonomous vehicles or robotics (realism metrics, simulated agents, scenario-based testing)
Experience with physics simulation, multibody dynamics, or granular materials
Experience with rare-event estimation, importance sampling, or surrogate models (e.g., Gaussian processes)
Experience with learned or generative world models
PhD in a quantitative field

About Us

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Why We Exist

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Principal AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services

Focus: AI Transformation Services for CoCounsel and Thomson Reuters solutions

Many in-house legal, tax, and trade teams now have access to AI. The harder question is what changes because of it: which work gets redesigned, what good looks like, what guardrails the work needs, and how leaders will know it is working.

As a Principal AI Transformation Consultant, you will help senior leaders answer those questions for the workflows that matter most, then lead the change and measure what it delivers — with CoCounsel Legal and CoCounsel for Tax and Trade at the center. You’ll work embedded with client teams, alongside Sales, our AI engineers, enablement specialists, and product teams, from the first client conversation through rollout and measured value.

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as Principal AI Transformation Consultant, Professional Services, you will:

Lead complex transformation engagements from discovery and value hypothesis through workflow redesign where needed, proof of value adoption, and value realization.
Advise senior leaders on priority AI-enabled workflows and the targeted changes to roles, skills, practices, controls, and ways of working needed to scale them.
Shape transformation opportunities from early customer discovery through delivery planning, defining achievable outcomes, scope, approach, estimates, and statements of work with Sales and specialist teams.
Own the hardest calls on your engagements: the approach when the path is unclear, the tradeoffs when stakeholders disagree, and the commitments we make to the customer on scope and outcomes.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Governance & Trust
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters

The architect team has four domains that together make the platform work for customers: Platform Advantage, Emerging Tech & UI Innovation, Data & AI Excellence, and Governance & Trust. This role sits in Governance & Trust, which covers identity, security, and audit.

Agents now take actions, call tools, and work with other agents, often across systems Salesforce doesn’t own. Each step prompts the same questions from a customer’s security and risk leaders: who is this agent acting as, what can it touch, who approved it, and how do we stop it?

You answer those questions with architecture, not assurances. When an AI program reaches the security review, the risk committee, or the Chief Information Security Officer, you show how identity, data access, agent authority, and audit work, and what it takes to prove it.

You start from the customer’s risk and business problem, not a product pitch. You stay engaged until the controls are in place, because trust is what lets AI scale.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

Design agent identity and access architecture: agents as first-class identities, least privilege, Open Authorization (OAuth) scoping, and a clear chain back to an accountable human
Advise on data security and privacy, including sharing and field-level access, encryption, masking, residency, and backup and retention
Define agent guardrails, runtime control, observability, and audit using the Einstein Trust Layer, deterministic controls, human-in-the-loop, governance of external agents, event monitoring, agent session tracing, and security information and event management (SIEM) integration
Lead AI governance and risk work, including risk tiering, approval gates, and regulatory readiness, while aligning C-suite stakeholders and working with pre-sale and post-sale teams to resolve platform-fit questions for customers

Minimum Requirements

5+ years in enterprise or solutions architecture, with direct experience influencing senior technical and business stakeholders and staying engaged through delivery, including recovering stalled work
Deep expertise in at least one of the five focus areas above, enough to be the final word in a room
Fluency across the Salesforce platform or adjacent security, identity, or governance technology, and experience using AI tooling to build solutions and work more efficiently
B.S., M.S. or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering or MIS

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of the other architect domains, enough to know when to hand off
Hands-on experience with Shield, Security Center, or the trust controls in Agentforce and MuleSoft
Security or AI governance certifications or Salesforce Architect credentials
Strong visual communication skills for architecture storytelling

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $173,460 - $269,080 annually There is a different range applicable to specific work locations. In California and New York, and select cities in the metropolitan areas of Boston, Chicago, Seattle, and Washington DC, the base pay range for this role in those locations is $190,750 - $295,890 per year. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

jobs.title: Lead Development Product Owner - AI Product Solutions
jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

The Lead Development Product Owner – AI Product Solutions
selected for this position will join AI enablement teams in USAA’s Technology organization.  The candidate will have an opportunity to support a value chain of AI delivery that runs from pilots through production.  The candidate selected for this position will be responsible for serving several AI domains and partnering with peers to manage dependencies and risks across the wider AI value chain. This includes working with multiple delivery teams and stakeholders through all stages of the development lifecycle. 

The candidate selected for this position will be accountable for attaining, understanding, and communicating business needs to manage backlogs of work including guiding teams of Data Scientist and AI Engineers in writing and refining features and stories, planning and prioritizing work, and managing risks to delivery plans. The candidate will also be responsible for ensuring development work adheres to applicable internal software development lifecycle controls. The candidate will demonstrate strong critical thinking, problem solving, and technical knowledge along with an expert ability to work across multiple delivery methodologies to plan and predictably deliver business value.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week.
This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ, or Charlotte, NC. Relocation assistance is not
available for this position.

What You'll Do

Works with business and Subject Matter Experts to understand business strategy and vision and then writes, refines, accepts and prioritizes stories, features or epics to support effective and compliant solutions while balancing investment and business value.
Owns and maintains a prioritized work backlog for a single or multiple Agile teams or program. Product backlog includes complete user stories or features with acceptance criteria so that they are consumable and testable by the Agile team or program. Reviews and accepts output of I/T and/or business development to ensure specified acceptance criteria have been completed.
Serves as a knowledgeable collaborator across multiple business or system domains; is expected to lead development across multiple teams at the program and Epic level.
Serves as direct representative of the business with one or more delivery teams throughout the product delivery cycle.
Participates in a cross-functional team of user experience partners, designers, business analysts, developers, testers and others to develop, execute, solution and release in alignment with program, portfolio or product road maps.
Partners with sponsors, stakeholders, and IT to facilitate, define and document relevant business processes, gaining an expert understanding of the needs, measures, and risks & controls for the improvement area.
Participates with portfolio, program and project level plans related to schedule, scope and resources.
Prepares the business for the change and provides tactics and metrics for benefits, adoption, and risk. Leverages existing change management routines, as needed.
Applies expert knowledge in the business development/execution discipline, regularly seeking out opportunities to enhance, improve and advance the function.
Coaches and mentors less experienced Product Owners, including Seniors.
Demonstrates expert knowledge in multiple business or system domains and capable of leading development across multiple teams at the program level.
Identifies engages, influences and leads business stakeholders and Subject Matter Experts across programs.
Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
8 years of experience in process improvement, project delivery, business/requirements analysis or directly related to supported business operations/product line.
Expert knowledge of the AI development lifecycle including data science run pilots and engineering run productionalization and hardening with a proven track record in using these skills to develop and manage products through the entire product life cycle.
Expert experience in analyzing business requirements, process flows and use cases to identify opportunities to streamline business processes in accordance with risk management framework and regulatory requirements.
Expert understanding and demonstrated use of Process Engineering methodologies and Change Management practices to translate business requirements into actionable functional specifications.
Expert ability to independently work to gather business requirements, process flows and use cases to develop and deliver on business capabilities within the approved methodology, writing user stories, and following the development process through user story acceptance.
Advanced experience analyzing and translating business requirements and proven ability to identify opportunities to streamline business processes in accordance with risk management framework and regulatory requirements.

What Sets You Apart

8 or more years of experience delivering successful AI / Machine Learning (ML) products.
5 or more years of experience in enterprise technology, Data Science, or AI/ML product/program management at a major financial institution.

new_jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - AI & Machine Learning
new_jobs.description:
Brief Description

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Harbor Health is a Texas-based payvider: one company that delivers care and stands behind the health plan that pays for it. Founded in Austin in 2022, Harbor has grown from two clinics into a primary and specialty care network spanning Austin, Dallas, San Antonio, El Paso, and Houston. Harbor pairs its clinics with its own health plan so members get coordinated primary and specialty care, no-deductible plans, and $0 specialist visits when referred by a Harbor clinician. We're building the infrastructure behind that model — the finance, actuarial, and operations functions that let care and coverage work as one system instead of two. If you're ready to help us build a better healthcare system in Texas, we'd love for you to bring your talents to our team!

Position Overview

Harbor Health runs a health plan and a medical group, so a model here can change what a clinician does for a member and what the health plan pays for it. We are hiring Staff Data Scientists to own a machine learning or AI system full-time, from design through daily use.

Right now there are two areas. One is an AI system we are building to recommend next steps to care teams, with large language models and agentic workflows, moving from a working prototype to something clinicians rely on. The other is the prediction models behind pricing, underwriting and care, which need a second look, clear quality bars and steady improvement. Neither is finished, and both affect what a member receives or what the health plan pays. We hire for this role on an ongoing basis, and the same kind of person will be needed in other parts of the business over time.

Position Duties & Responsibilities

Build AI agentic systems and production-grade machine learning models that become core data science assets for Harbor.
Own each one end to end, from the data and definitions to the model, its deployment and its use, and stay with it until you can show what it changed.
Work with clinicians and with engineering and product teams so each one is developed and deployed safely and efficiently, and make the build-versus-buy calls with them.
Set the quality bar: the metrics, validation and release checks that tell everyone when a model or an agent can be trusted, and when it cannot.
Set the roadmap and stay close to the leaders who depend on it. Disagree with them when the evidence points elsewhere, and leave with a decision or a test that settles it.
Make other data scientists better: mentor senior data scientists and raise the review bar.
Use AI in your daily work, efficiently and responsibly, and share what works with the team.

Desired Professional Skills & Experience

Deep expertise in machine learning or AI systems, shown by work that is in use today. That may be large language models and agentic workflows, or predictive modeling on messy real-world data.
You carry a whole system without day-to-day direction and keep your manager informed of everything happening in it, not only the modeling.
Daily fluency with AI agentic development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. You verify, test and challenge what agents and models produce, and build repeatable workflows that others on the team adopt.
Sound evaluation judgment: you know how wrong an answer could be. You choose the metric that fits the decision and name the risk it hides, such as a model that scores well while underestimating cost.
Typically 8+ years of hands-on data science, machine learning or applied statistics, with strong Python and SQL. We work in Snowflake and dbt; experience on any modern cloud data platform transfers.
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience. An advanced degree is a plus.

Preferred

Relevant healthcare experience is preferred, not required. Any of these helps:

Putting a machine learning or language model system into clinical use, with its users in the feedback loop.
Health plan, provider or value-based care work with claims, eligibility or clinical data, or building tools with physicians and care teams.
Prediction works on cost, utilization or risk, including risk adjustment (HHS-HCC, RAF) and pricing.

If you come from outside healthcare, for example insurance, credit or applied machine learning, and have solved comparable problems, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

Annual bonus eligibility
Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits
401(k) with company match
Generous PTO and paid holidays
Professional development and growth opportunities
