new_jobs.title: Data Science and AI Mgr
new_jobs.description:
Data Science and AI Manager (US-O)

Would you like to join the Logistics Company for the World? DHL Supply Chain is just that.

Become an essential part of everyday life, by contributing to an organization that is Connecting People and Improving Lives. If you have a passion for people, a desire to problem-solve, and eagerness to pursue continuous improvement opportunities… we look forward to exploring career possibilities with you!

Job Description

We are seeking a Data Science and AI Manager to lead the development and delivery of cutting-edge data science, optimization, and AI solutions that drive operational excellence across global logistics operations. Working at the intersection of advanced analytics, machine learning, operations research, and Generative AI, you will shape strategic initiatives that improve warehousing, transportation, packaging, and supply chain performance. In addition to providing technical leadership, you will partner with senior stakeholders, manage project teams, and mentor data science professionals to accelerate innovation and business value across the organization.

Responsibilities

Leads and delivers strategic data science, AI, and optimization initiatives across warehousing, transportation, network design, process mining, and supply chain operations.
Manages the development of cloud-based analytics solutions and decision-support tools, ensuring scalable, reliable, and business-focused outcomes.
Partners with senior stakeholders to define business challenges, shape analytical approaches, and drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Provides technical leadership across machine learning, predictive analytics, Generative AI, optimization modelling, and application development using technologies such as Python and Java.
Leads pilots, proof-of-concepts, and innovation programs, working closely with regional teams, IT, operations, and business leaders to validate and scale solutions.
Mentors and develops data scientists and analysts, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and innovation across global teams.

Required Education And Experience

A Master's degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related discipline, required.
PhD, preferred.
Proven experience leading data science, AI, or advanced analytics projects, with the ability to translate complex business challenges into impactful solutions, required.
Strong expertise in machine learning, operations research, optimization techniques, statistics, forecasting, predictive modelling, and Generative AI, required.
Advanced programming and technical skills, including experience with Python, Java, cloud-based applications, and scalable solution development, required.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and build strong cross-functional partnerships, required.

Our Organization has a business casual environment and focuses on teamwork, associate development, training, and continuous improvement. We offer competitive wages, excellent affordable insurance benefits (including health, dental, vision and life), 401K plan, paid vacation and holidays.

Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

new_jobs.title: Engineer Lead (FDE) - AI Assurance and Evaluations
new_jobs.description:
Engineer Lead (FDE) – AI Assurance and Evaluations

FDE – Forward Deployment Engineer

Location:
This role requires associates to be in-office 1 - 2 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Alternate locations may be considered if candidates reside within a commuting distance from an office.

Please note that per our policy on hybrid/virtual work, candidates not within a reasonable commuting distance from the posting location(s) will not be considered for employment, unless an accommodation is granted as required by law.

The Engineer Lead
will be responsible for full delivery of end to end system development and maintenance on medium Enterprise wide technology platforms.

How You Will Make An Impact

Maintains active relationships with customers to determine business requirements and leads requirements gathering meetings.
Primary duties may include, but are not limited to.
Leads requirements gathering meetings and reviews designs with the business.
Leads efforts with Web and marketing team to increase the presence of web products.
May implement improvements in stability, performance, and scalability across major business-critical systems.
May implement process to reduce barriers and roadblocks in projects, services, and processes in order to operate more efficiently.
Owns the change request process and coordinates with other teams as necessary.
Develops and owns list of final enhancements.
Develops and defines application scope and objectives and supervises the preparation of technical and/or functional specifications from with programs will be written.
Performs technical design reviews and code reviews.
Ensures unit test is completed and meets the test plan requirements, system testing is completed and system is implemented according to plan.
Responsible for delivery of application technology solutions and data information planning effort.
Coordinates and manages on-call support and owns the system monitoring process.
Owns the technical development environment and works on the Enterprise team.
Leads multiple or large projects and facilitates large group JAD sessions for requirements, modeling in several disciplines.
Leads vendor evaluation and analysis.

Minimum Requirements

Requires an BA/BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field of study and a minimum of 7 years related experience; multi platform, and multi-dimensional experience required, as well as experience with business and technical applications; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

Preferred Skills, Capabilities And Experiences

Proficiency with Python for building evaluation utilities, test harnesses, data pipelines, and automation scripts.
Experience with API testing (REST/JSON), including authentication patterns, contract validation, negative testing, and performance/smoke testing.
Hands-on test automation experience (unit/integration/end-to-end), including building repeatable regression suites and integrating tests into CI pipelines.
LLM basics, including core concepts such as tokens/context windows, temperature/top-p sampling, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) fundamentals, and common failure modes (hallucinations, prompt injection, bias).
Familiarity with prompting and evaluation frameworks (prompt versioning, test cases, golden datasets, automated scoring), including qualitative + quantitative evaluation approaches.
Data analytics skills to measure model/application quality and operational performance (e.g., KPI definition, experiment analysis, dashboards; comfort with SQL and basic statistical concepts preferred).
Experience mentoring others and provide troubleshooting support strongly preferred.
